prefix: One high-resolution landscape 3:2 educational process photograph for CRYST. Match soft mint/lavender studio product photography, realistic glass and materials, gentle diffuse light, close framing with entire apparatus visible, uncluttered pastel tabletop. One scene, no collage, no logos, no typography or labels. No decorative framing or extra borders. Show exactly this stage, not a later result. Subject:
images: candy-setup

Clear glass jar of transparent sugar syrup, a bare wooden skewer with only a thin dusting of white sugar held vertically in centre by a wooden clothes peg across rim, skewer tip above bottom, no large crystals yet.
A sugar-coated skewer held in clear syrup by a clothes peg
Hold the dry coated skewer in the syrup, clear of the jar's bottom.
candy-early

Clear glass jar of transparent pale golden syrup, wooden skewer held in centre with clothes peg across rim. Only a sparse scattering of tiny sugar crystals attached to skewer, still mostly bare wood, early growth rather than finished candy.
Tiny sugar crystals beginning to appear on a skewer in syrup
Check for the first tiny crystals without shaking the jar.
bridge-setup

Two glass jars containing clear water spaced apart with a white plate between. A clean bare thick white cotton cord spans jars with ends submerged and middle sagging down over plate. Absolutely no crystals or deposits yet.
A bare cotton cord linking two jars above a plate
Dip both cord ends into the solution and let the middle hang over the plate.
paint-station
Unmarked flat black sheet of paper on protected mint tabletop, dry paintbrush and empty glass bowl arranged beside paper. No artwork, paint, crystals or patterns yet.
Blank black paper with a brush and an empty mixing bowl
Protect your workspace and place the black paper flat before painting.
paint-action

Black paper on pastel tabletop, paintbrush touching the end of a single wet translucent snowflake brushstroke, small glass bowl of clear salt solution beside paper. Incomplete wet design with faint reflective lines, no dry white crystalline pattern yet.
A brush laying down a wet snowflake design on black paper
Paint with the cooled solution, then leave the paper flat to dry.
choose-seed

Macro view of several small transparent alum seed crystals on shallow glass dish, one well formed tiny octahedral clear seed isolated near dish edge beside magnifying glass and fine transparent fishing line. No large crystals.
A small clear seed crystal beside a magnifying glass and fishing line
Choose a regular seed shape and ask an adult to attach the fine line gently.
alum-growing

Small clear octahedral alum seed tied to thin transparent fishing line suspended from horizontal glass rod across jar rim, seed submerged halfway down a glass jar of clear transparent solution and clear of sides and base. No large finished crystal.
A small alum seed hanging freely in clear solution
Suspend the seed in cooled solution without touching the sides or bottom.
plain-shells
Two clean natural scallop seashells without any crystalline deposits on a lavender tabletop beside empty clear shallow glass bowl and safety goggles. Realistic bare ridged shells.
Clean bare seashells beside an empty glass bowl
Choose clean shells and check their edges before preparing the bath.
shell-soaking
One plain natural scallop seashell immersed in clear water inside shallow glass bowl. No crystalline crust or growth yet. Fine shell ridges visible through transparent liquid. Pastel tabletop.
A plain seashell soaking in a clear solution
Set the shell into the cooled solution and leave it undisturbed overnight.
garden-cooling

A shallow transparent glass bowl containing clear pale green solution on a clean refrigerator shelf with simple white interior, bowl just placed to cool, absolutely no crystal clusters yet. Close-up bowl visible completely, cool soft light.
A bowl of pale green solution resting on a refrigerator shelf
An adult places the cooled bowl in the refrigerator; leave it undisturbed overnight.
lab-empty

Three identical empty transparent glass jars aligned on pastel mint tabletop, blank observation notebook, pencil, three identical bare cotton strings and three pencils laid beside jars. No water or crystals yet.
Three empty matching jars and identical strings ready for an experiment
Prepare matching jars and decide which condition you will change.
lab-filled

Three identical open transparent glass jars, exactly equal clear liquid levels, identical plain white cotton strings hanging from identical pencils across rims, all jars uncovered, no crystals yet. Clean mint tabletop.
Three open jars with equal liquid levels and identical suspended strings
Start every jar with equal solution and the same type of string.
lab-record

Three glass experiment jars with cotton strings and sparse white salt crystal deposits, different water levels, first jar open second partly paper covered third mostly paper covered leaving small gap. Blank observation notebook and pencil beside jars with simple hand drawn water level marks and dots but no words.
Growing jars beside a notebook for recording water levels and crystal changes
Observe at the same time each day and record the water level and visible growth.
lab-results

Three identical glass jars with cotton strings after evaporation experiment, first jar much lower water level with many fine white salt crystals, second intermediate water level and modest growth, third higher water level and sparse growth. The paper covers removed and set beside jars. No text.
Three jars showing different final water levels and crystal growth
Compare your jars and decide whether the results match your prediction.
cave-sketch

Open sketchbook on pastel lavender tabletop with simple pencil sketch of an open front shoebox cave and small angular crystal shapes drawn inside, coloured pencils beside page, unmodified empty cardboard shoebox in background. No words or finished model.
A pencil sketch planning crystals inside a shoebox cave
Sketch your cave and decide where you want the crystals to go.
cave-build

Unfinished open front cardboard shoebox cave model with rough grey air dry clay rocks partly formed, spare clay and cardboard offcuts beside box. No crystals, no paint, no decorations yet. Pastel tabletop.
An unfinished cardboard cave with newly shaped clay walls
Build the rocky walls and leave the structure to dry completely.
cave-decorate

Partly painted open front handmade cardboard and clay cave, half grey walls half purple painted details, small dry white crystal clusters on a tray beside model, one cluster being positioned at entrance, small unlabelled glue bottle and brush beside it. Model clearly only partly decorated.
A partly painted cave with dry crystal clusters ready to attach
Paint the dry model, then attach dry crystals with child-safe glue.
detective-search

Three everyday discoveries arranged on pastel tabletop: unlabelled small glass jar of salt, unlabelled small glass jar of sugar, clear ice cube in a shallow dish. Smartphone lying beside samples with camera view of samples visible, no interface text.
Salt, sugar and an ice cube collected for photographing
Find and photograph three familiar crystal samples.
detective-examine

Close macro view through large magnifying glass of white cubic table salt grains on a dark shallow dish, adjacent separate dish of fine sugar grains and notebook corner, visibly distinct tiny grain shapes. Pastel tabletop.
A magnifying glass revealing tiny grains in a sample dish
Compare each sample's shape and colour through the magnifying glass.
detective-report

Open observation notebook with three small attached photographic prints showing salt grains, sugar grains and an ice cube, simple pencil drawings of sample shapes beside each photo, pencil on page, no legible words. Mint tabletop.
An observation page with photos and drawings of three crystal samples
Pair each discovery photo with a drawing and a fact about its shape.
colour-white

One shallow white ceramic laboratory dish containing only white dry crystalline powder on a pastel tabletop. A small separate sealed glass vial of blue crystalline granules behind it for comparison. No flame, heater, hands or dropper.
White dry powder in a laboratory dish after the teacher's demonstration
Record the change from blue crystals to white powder as water is removed.
colour-return

White ceramic laboratory dish of white crystalline powder with a small freshly wetted blue patch directly under a glass water dropper. Clear boundary between dry white powder and damp blue region. Pastel tabletop. No heating equipment or hands.
A wetted patch of white powder turning blue under a water dropper
Watch the teacher add water and observe the blue colour returning.
colour-report

Open observation notebook with three small photographic prints in sequence showing blue granules, white powder, blue granules again. Simple hand drawn arrows between photos, pencil beside page, no words or letters. Pastel lavender tabletop.
An observation page showing blue, white and blue appearances in order
Record the colour sequence and explain the reversible change.
underwater-ready

Empty clear laboratory beaker with a glass bottle of clear liquid and small separate white dishes of orange and blue mineral granules, all arranged on pastel mint tabletop beside safety goggles. No tubes or crystal growth yet, no labels or text.
An empty beaker and prepared demonstration materials beside safety goggles
Listen to your teacher and observe the prepared demonstration materials.
underwater-early

Transparent glass laboratory beaker filled with clear liquid, a few tiny orange and teal granules at base and only two very short thin mineral shoots just emerging a few millimetres above them. Mostly empty clear water, no tall branching structures yet.
The first short mineral shoots appearing at the bottom of a beaker
Look near the base for the first solid structures appearing.
underwater-report

A small photograph of a mature orange teal branching chemical garden in a beaker placed on an open notebook beside a simple matching coloured pencil drawing of branching tubes, coloured pencils on pastel tabletop. No words or text.
A notebook drawing beside a photo of branching mineral structures
Draw a formation and compare its shape with the demonstration.
blue-liquid

Single transparent laboratory beaker of clear blue liquid with stainless stirring rod beside it and small shallow dish of blue mineral granules safely behind glass. No thread, suspended seed or crystal growth in the liquid yet. Pastel mint tabletop.
A beaker of blue solution before a seed crystal is added
Observe the teacher's solution and compare it with the solid sample.
blue-growth

Transparent glass beaker of clear blue solution, thin thread hanging from glass rod across rim supporting medium sized angular blue crystal, visibly larger than a tiny seed but still submerged and not touching the container. Small blank photograph card of a tiny seed beside beaker for size comparison. Pastel tabletop.
A blue crystal growing on a thread beside a photo of its smaller starting seed
Compare the growing crystal with your earlier observations from a safe distance.
